# Spec Delta: voucher-redemption

<!-- Generated by re-skills to-openspec from requirements/requirements.csv on 2026-11-03. Keep the R-IDs in headings; change requirement text in the register and re-export. -->

## Purpose

Members of the Harbourline Rewards programme exchange posted points for vouchers worth SGD 1 per 100 points, and the TillPoint POS asks the loyalty service to validate a voucher before the cashier applies it (R-013, R-014, R-015, R-038, R-039).

## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: R-013 IF a member requests a redemption of fewer
<!-- R-013 -->
IF a member requests a redemption of fewer than 500 points, THEN the loyalty service SHALL reject the redemption request.

#### Scenario: R-013 main case (derived from the requirement text)
- **WHEN** a member requests a redemption of fewer than 500 points
- **THEN** the loyalty service SHALL reject the redemption request.

### Requirement: R-014 WHEN the loyalty service accepts a redemption, the
<!-- R-014 -->
WHEN the loyalty service accepts a redemption, the loyalty service SHALL issue the member a voucher worth SGD 1 per 100 redeemed points.

#### Scenario: R-014 main case (derived from the requirement text)
- **WHEN** the loyalty service accepts a redemption
- **THEN** the loyalty service SHALL issue the member a voucher worth SGD 1 per 100 redeemed points.

### Requirement: R-015 IF the TillPoint POS asks the loyalty service
<!-- R-015 -->
IF the TillPoint POS asks the loyalty service to validate a voucher that is already applied, THEN the loyalty service SHALL reject the request.

#### Scenario: R-015 main case (derived from the requirement text)
- **WHEN** the TillPoint POS asks the loyalty service to validate a voucher that is already applied
- **THEN** the loyalty service SHALL reject the request.

### Requirement: R-038 IF a member requests a redemption of more
<!-- R-038 -->
IF a member requests a redemption of more points than the member's posted points, THEN the loyalty service SHALL reject the redemption request.

#### Scenario: R-038 main case (derived from the requirement text)
- **WHEN** a member requests a redemption of more points than the member's posted points
- **THEN** the loyalty service SHALL reject the redemption request.

### Requirement: R-039 IF the TillPoint POS asks the loyalty service
<!-- R-039 -->
IF the TillPoint POS asks the loyalty service to validate a voucher code that does not exist, THEN the loyalty service SHALL reject the request as not found.

#### Scenario: R-039 main case (derived from the requirement text)
- **WHEN** the TillPoint POS asks the loyalty service to validate a voucher code that does not exist
- **THEN** the loyalty service SHALL reject the request as not found.
